positions.title: Lab & Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and documented a workstation snapshot automation framework, leveraging Kubernetes OpenShift.
• Transitioned legacy Python-based solutions to Ansible for Linux and Windows workstation management.
- Service mesh implementation and management
• Automated deployment of containerized DHCP servers and other internal utilities. managing VLAN configuration and network attachment with CI/CD pipelines and dynamic server configs.
• Managed multi-tenancy Kubernetes cluster deployments with ArgoCD and service mesh, providing infrastructure support for 5G ORAN implementations.
• Designed and implemented Python and Django-based network mapping and management APIs.
• Troubleshooting support across Linux-based systems and a wide variety of R&D lab hardware.
- Extensive layer 2 & 3 networking.

positions.title: Research Scholar
positions.description:
2023-2024: CPython Internals
Developed a custom implementation of the Python programming language. Custom-created components such as tokenization processes, recursive grammar rules, and a PEG parser. Built an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) and implemented opcode generation, culminating in a custom Py Evaluation Loop. Gained ample experience with the compilation process.

2022-2023: REST Architecture and API Development
Specialized in designing, developing, and testing RESTful APIs. Utilized industry-standard tools like Postman and Insomnia for API testing and documentation. Focused on best practices in API architecture, including comprehensive documentation of discoveries and implementations.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Postman API · Research · Problem Solving · Linux · Software Development · Docker · REST APIs · Insomnia · CPython Internals

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• DevSecOps pipelines using GitLab. Integrated automated security checks, integration testing, and automated deployment and publishing of mobile apps.
• Extensive AWS resource management and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with AWS SAM: Lambda functions, DynamoDB tables, API Gateway, CloudWatch alarms, and SNS topics. CloudWatch Log Groups for streamlined logging and embedded alarms to monitor errors, latency, and traffic with automated notifications via SNS.
• Terraform IaC with Ansible to create a development platform.
• Automated Red Hat Enterprise Linux security baselines using OpenSCAP and Ansible.
- Assisted in Cloud Infrastructure Migration: migrated organizational resources from AWS to DigitalOcean.
- Led DevOps Transformation Initiative: Introduced DevOps practices across the organization, streamlining development and operations processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Linux · Docker · DevOps · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Gitlab · Relational Database Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · AWS SAM · AWS CloudFormation

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description: My experience as a shift supervisor allowed me to refine my communication and leadership skills in a professional setting. I effectively directed team members, fostering a cohesive work environment to achieve production, merchandising, and sales objectives. I demonstrated strong attention to detail while adhering to Emergency Action Plans (EAP), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and established safety protocols.

organizations.name: CompTIA AITP
organizations.description:
AITP is the Association of Information Technology Professionals, a national organization dedicated to ethics and professionalism in the field of information technology.

AITP encourages the development of educational programs for the self-improvement of its members, embraces high standards of competence and professional attitude, promotes awareness of the impact of information processing on society, and stresses members' responsibility to employers and to society.
